rules.message: Page titles go through PageHeader — never a bare <h1> in a page body (PLACEMENT.md, Header slots).
Use the DS table primitives, not a raw <table> (ADOPTION.md gate 2).
Use the Button primitive, not a bare <button> (ADOPTION.md gate 2).
Use semantic tokens (bg-muted, text-muted-foreground, Badge variant), not a literal Tailwind palette class (audit-signals: literal-color).
Use the shadcn atom — Input / Select / Textarea (audit-signals: raw-html-control).
